full_details: In the morning the part of Navarre had a blank margin, and you wrote no new line on it. At noon you stayed home. The carrier's yard at the Bell had been full since before noon, and you did not leave the afternoon comedy to meet it. At half past five the six packhorses were still steaming. Hobbins gave you the road in prices, and Anne's letter: the money came, the children's news, and the warning about Quiney. You paid twopence. You wrote the fourth line on the corner of the table, and he read it back, which he did not do in the spring. You left her jokes where she put them. At the ordinary you declined the crust. Daniel had come to the king last week in a plain cloak. The two shillings were April's book, not the supper. You parted at Paul's Chain with no edge between you.
one_sentence: You played Navarre, met Hobbins after the comedy, added a fourth line at the Bell, and ate the wardens with Daniel.
title: Six horses at the Bell, then supper with Daniel
